document_title: Customize work item fields in team-managed spaces
content:
- Fields third-party apps created for you
You can drag previously created fields into your work type to reuse them. Using the same field between more than one work type makes it easier to sort, search, and report on those fields.
When a field appears on more than one work type in the same space, the fields share the same name and description. If you change the name in one work type, it will change in the others that use that field. Checkbox and dropdown fields also share their available options, but the field can have a unique default value on each work type.
Fields in team-managed spaces are contained within the space itself. Currently, you can't share a field created in one team-managed space with another team-managed space, or with a company-managed space.
Similarly, you can't use a custom field created in a company-managed space on your team-managed space work items.
Edit custom fields
To edit a custom field:
- Next to the name of your space in the sidebar, select More actions (•••), then Space settings. Then go to Fields.
- Find the field you want to edit on the table, then use the More (•••) menu to select Edit field. To remove a field, select Remove field instead.
- Edit any of the field's options like its default description, default values, or other options.
- Select Save changes. Once the field is in your space, it’ll appear on the table on the Fields page.
Your changes update across all your work types that use the field in your space.
You can create up to 50 custom fields in a team-managed space.
Edit number fields
To customize a number field:
- Next to your space's name in the sidebar, select More actions (), then Space settings.
- Select Fields.
